entries.title: Fancy Friday
entries.alt: Bæver retter sin gyldne butterfly ved et klaver. Han har blå fløjlssmoking og briller, og den brede, flade hale ligger på gulvet.
entries.prompt:
Create ONE original finished 3:2 landscape editorial illustration, intended as a character website scene. Generous framing so all character-defining parts are inside the canvas, no panels or collage. Character is prominent, dominant at center with environment on both sides. Rich detailed painterly soft dimensional illustration, original character identity from reference. No visible text, signs with letters, captions, branding, signatures or watermarks.
The attached portrait is the exact identity reference for the same friendly anthropomorphic adult beaver: compact sturdy build, warm chestnut brown fur, rounded beaver ears, tan muzzle with two large centered incisors, familiar brown slightly squared rectangular eyeglasses, broad flat dark brown scaly paddle tail with crosshatch texture, thick paws. Keep the recognisable face and relative proportions. On Fancy Friday he wears a beautifully fitted midnight blue velvet dinner jacket, cream shirt, subtle honey-gold bow tie and tailored taupe trousers. The full or nearly full figure stands beside the end of a compact dark piano in an intimate indoor lounge, making a last adjustment to the collar before the evening, with small brass lamp on the piano, warm parquet floor, amber wall lamps and dark blue window beyond. Body in three-quarter turn so the broad tail lays diagonally into clear foreground space behind him and is recognisable, both glasses and two incisors sharply visible. Rich textured painterly 3D illustration matching reference, quietly pleased smile, warm inviting Friday light. No other people, no brand, no printed text.

entries.title: Hawaii-onsdag
entries.alt: Bæver har en blå blomsterskjorte på og holder fast i en flettet parasol på en træbro ved havet. Hans flade hale hviler på broen.
